surface-raised.$description: Separated from the ground without elevation: code blocks, inputs. No shadow — compiler output does not float.

text-muted.$description: Metadata: namespace, counts, timestamps. 4.75:1 on light, 4.64:1 on dark — AA, unlike the 3.10:1 it replaces.

rule.$description: Hairlines. Carries the separation that shadows used to. Has a dark value, which the horizontal-rule colour it replaces did not.

accent.$description: Links, including wiki-links and tags. 4.94:1 on light, 6.24:1 on dark — replaces nord8's 1.74:1 on light.

accent-wash.$description: Selection ground: the active view in the sidebar, the active index group. Precomposed accent tints over surface (8% light, 14% dark) because light-dark() forbids runtime alpha mixing. Text on it wears the text role — accent itself falls under AA on the light wash.

syntax-comment.$description: Code comments and quotes. Syntax roles are gated against surface-raised — the code ground — not the page. 5.47:1 on light, 4.71:1 on dark.

syntax-keyword.$description: Keywords, literals, tag and selector names. 5.70:1 on light, 4.70:1 on dark.

syntax-entity.$description: Named things: titles, types, functions, attributes. 5.47:1 on light, 4.83:1 on dark.

syntax-string.$description: String and regexp literals. 5.47:1 on light, 4.94:1 on dark.

syntax-number.$description: Numeric literals. 5.42:1 on light, 4.71:1 on dark.

color.$description: Semantic layer. Components reference only these; never a primitive directly. Each colour role carries a light and a dark value, emitted as CSS light-dark().

mono.$description: New. Typed primitives — [[reference]], #[[tag]], ctx_path — are syntax, and the product's whole claim is that they are typed. Typography should say so.

space.$description: 4px base. Replaces the ad-hoc 32px used almost everywhere today.

radius.$description: Reduced from 2/4/8 to 2/4. Nothing in a compiler's output is pillowy.
